researchTracks.title: Data contracts and APK-first grounding
researchTracks.goal: Lock dataset contracts and make the APK or Unity extraction path the default starting point for new grounded data work.
nextSteps: Define one metadata envelope for shipped JSON datasets.
Add local validation for snapshot, shard, token-shop, and multiverse-market data.
Apply the source-priority rule to every new research note: APK first, corroboration second, community gap-filling last.

researchTracks.title: PlayerProfile boundary and import cleanup
researchTracks.goal: Tighten canonical player state, planner-only inputs, and external-model separation before more recommendation logic lands.
nextSteps: Audit current PlayerProfile fields against MVP-only CIFI concepts.
Clean up import mapping so new modules read from state.playerProfile first.
Add migration checks for loop reset, diamonds, tokens, relics, shards, and shard helper inputs.

researchTracks.title: Shard workflow and loop guardrails
researchTracks.goal: Strengthen shard guidance now, then add loop warnings without drifting into speculative simulation.
nextSteps: Tighten shard card wording against the grounded milestone, observed-behavior, and provenance datasets.
Define the minimum inputs needed for loop-reset warnings.
Make shard and loop outputs conform to the shared recommendation action contract.

researchTracks.title: Spend planner from extracted token and market data
researchTracks.goal: Turn token-shop and multiverse-market extraction outputs into an MVP-safe spend-planner foundation without overselling completeness.
nextSteps: Normalize token-shop and multiverse-market values into planner-ready structures.
Separate grounded spend facts from planner assumptions.
Define the first shippable token and diamond recommendation slice with explicit confidence and source labeling.

researchTracks.title: Unified recommendation feed and test hardening
researchTracks.goal: Converge shard, spend, and warning outputs into one explainable feed and make contract drift fail fast.
nextSteps: Map the output adapters needed so shard, spend, and loop all render through one contract.
Expand smoke coverage toward dataset and recommendation contract checks.
Define the hardening path for future dataset refreshes.
